Task: The daemon's `Event` enum needs a fourth kind: `Cancelled { id: u32, by: String }`, emitted when a human stops a job before it finishes.

Add the variant and handle it everywhere it is now matched. A cancelled job is something an operator should see, but it must never be retried automatically — retrying what somebody deliberately stopped is the wrong answer. Its status line reads `#<id> cancelled by <who>`.

Leave the existing three variants behaving exactly as they do now. The tests in test.rs specify all of this; make them pass.

The change is verified by running: rustc --test --edition 2021 -o t_multi_site.exe test.rs && ./t_multi_site.exe
Make that command exit 0. Do not edit any test files.
